description: Happy Tails Pet Spa in Akron, Ohio offers comprehensive grooming services including full grooms, bath and blow dry, and bath-only options across numerous dog breeds from small to extra-large. The spa provides specialized add-on services such as conditioning treatments, deshedding, tooth brushing, and anal gland expression, along with breed-specific pricing for dogs ranging from Chihuahuas to Great Danes and Mastiffs. Customers can book appointments online at any time with email confirmation, and the business accepts walk-in calls during operating hours.
